headline: Simbhaoli Sugars Limited enters Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
sum: Simbhaoli Sugars Limited initiated a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, with formal intimation filed to NSE on 17 August 2026.
implication: CIRP admission triggers a 180-day statutory resolution window (extendable to 270 days) and places the company under an insolvency resolution professional's control; creditors' claims must be verified against the company's books, and any resolution plan must be approved by creditors holding ≥66% voting share to exit CIRP or proceed to liquidation.
detail: Simbhaoli Sugars Limited, a sugar manufacturing entity based in Uttar Pradesh, formally intimated its entry into CIRP via NSE Form G filing on 17 August 2026. The CIRP process, initiated under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 (IBC), typically follows an order of admission by the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT). During CIRP, the company is managed by an insolvency resolution professional (IRP) who takes control of assets and liabilities, invites bids for resolution plans, and facilitates creditor voting within the statutory timeline.
